lines.en: ERROR ADVANCING TO SUNDAY
lines.zh: ERROR ADVANCING TO SUNDAY

lines.en: To see a World in a Grain of Sand\nAnd a Heaven in a Wild Flower
lines.zh:
一沙一世界
一花一天堂

lines.en: Hold Infinity in the palm of your hand\nAnd Eternity in an hour
lines.zh:
无限掌中置
刹那成永恒

lines.en: A Robin Red breast in a Cage\nPuts all Heaven in a Rage
lines.zh:
笼中一只知更鸟
惹得天庭怒火烧

lines.en: A Dove house filld with Doves & Pigeons\nShudders Hell thr' all its regions
lines.zh:
鸽舍挤满鸽与鸠
地狱万界齐颤抖

lines.en: A dog starvd at his Masters Gate\nPredicts the ruin of the State
lines.zh:
饿犬蜷卧主门外
预示家国将倾颓

lines.en: A Horse misusd upon the Road\nCalls to Heaven for Human blood
lines.zh:
道路之上马受虐
向苍天讨要人血

lines.en: Each outcry of the hunted Hare\nA fibre from the Brain does tear
lines.zh:
猎物野兔每一声哀鸣
都从你脑中撕下一缕神经

lines.en: I wind up being swallowed by the bed sometime in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 午夜前后的某个时刻,我被床吞没了。

lines.en: My skin fuses to the fabric of the sheets and I need to peel it off each time I roll over to get a dose of colder air.
lines.zh: 我的皮肤和床单的织物融在了一起,每次翻身换一口凉气,都得把自己撕下来。

lines.en: I hear the door open at several points but never have the resolve to open my eyes and see who it is.
lines.zh: 有好几次,我听见门开了,却始终没有睁开眼睛看看是谁的气力。

lines.en: Nor do I need to because it could only be one person.
lines.zh: 也无须看,因为那只可能是同一个人。

lines.en: I hear it close just as often as I hear it open- but I guess it wouldn’t really be possible to hear one without the other now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 门关上的次数和门打开的一样多——不过想想,只听见其一而听不见其二,本来也不可能。

lines.en: I clutch the sheets and focus on the threads of fabric, fraying from being constantly used and abused over the years.
lines.zh: 我攥着床单,盯着织物的线头——经年累月的使用与糟蹋,让它们起了毛。

lines.en: I wonder if these too are wiped clean each time I come down from the rooftop under a starlit sky.
lines.zh: 我不知道,每次我从星空下的天台下来,这些东西是不是也被一并擦干净了。

lines.en: And, if not, perhaps it’s time for new ones.
lines.zh: 如果没有,那也许该换新的了。

lines.en: I poke a hole in them with my index finger and proceed to sink the tip of it into the mattress.
lines.zh: 我用食指在床单上戳了个洞,把指尖沉进床垫。

lines.en: It’s soft.
lines.zh: 很软。

lines.en: Not like the flesh of a [young]girl, but like a mattress.
lines.zh: 不像 [young] 女孩的肌肤,倒像个床垫。

lines.en: The door opens again. It is the same girl.
lines.zh: 门又开了。还是那个女孩。

lines.en: This time, she makes it to the foot of the bed and crouches down to whisper something into my ear.
lines.zh: 这一次,她走到床尾蹲下,把一句话轻轻送进我的耳朵。

lines.en: : I can’t sleep.
lines.zh: : 我睡不着。

lines.en: The words register, but mean close to nothing as I’m unable to react or respond.
lines.zh: 那句话进了脑子,却几乎没有意义——我无法反应,也无法回应。

lines.en: In fact, these thoughts likely aren’t even my own.
lines.zh: 事实上,这些念头多半都不属于我。

lines.en: I am asleep.
lines.zh: 我在沉睡。

lines.en: I’ve been swallowed.
lines.zh: 我已被吞没。

lines.en: And there is nothing left for me here.
lines.zh: 这里已经没有剩下任何属于我的东西。

lines.en: The rest of the night or the day disappears.
lines.zh: 这一夜剩下的时光,或这一天,就此消失。

lines.en: I can’t tell which it was or is.
lines.zh: 我分不清那究竟是夜,还是昼。

lines.en: : Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早安。

lines.en: : What? Aren’t you glad to see me?
lines.zh: : 怎么?见到我不高兴吗?

lines.en: I am asleep.
lines.zh: 我在沉睡。

lines.en: I’ve been swallowed.
lines.zh: 我已被吞没。

lines.en: And there is nothing left for me anywhere.
lines.zh: 任何地方都已经没有剩下任何属于我的东西。

lines.en: : You’re late, you know.
lines.zh: : 你迟到了,知道吗。

lines.en: : And look at you- sleeping in on the lord’s day. You need to wake up or God will cut your hands off and feed them to his angels. It’s true because I said so.
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧你——主日睡懒觉。你得起床,不然上帝会砍下你的双手,喂给他的天使。这是真的,因为是我说的。

lines.en: : Room for one more in there? If you’re so insistent on going to Hell, I may as well come with you.
lines.zh: : 里面还挤得下一个人吗?你要是一意孤行要去地狱,那我顺便奉陪。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : But, you know...
lines.zh: : 不过,你知道的……

lines.en: : Sooner or later, you’re going to have to come out of there.
lines.zh: : 迟早有一天,你得从那里出来。

lines.en: I awaken regurgitated, covered in acids and fluids I carried with me out of some sort of celestial esophagus.
lines.zh: 我被吐了出来,浑身覆满酸液与黏液——那是我从某条天界的食道里带出来的行李。

lines.en: And before me stands one of the only things that I have come to terms with loving.
lines.zh: 而站在我面前的,是我少数几个已经承认自己爱着的东西之一。

lines.en: : Is that-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Does it...look okay?
lines.zh: : 它……好看吗?

lines.en: I remember that dress.
lines.zh: 我记得那条裙子。

lines.en: I-
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei?……

lines.en: : Should I...have not worn this?...
lines.zh: : 我是不是……不该穿这条?……

lines.en: : I know I said I’d never touch any of the things we locked away, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道我说过再也不碰我们封起来的东西,但是……

lines.en: : Good morning, Ami.
lines.zh: : 早安,Ami。

lines.en: : Good morning, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 早安,Sensei……

lines.en: : I had a bad dream.
lines.zh: : 我做了个噩梦。

lines.en: : You can tell me about it on the way there.
lines.zh: : 路上讲给我听吧。

lines.en: Ami nods through a half-broken smile and the sound of suppressed delight crosses her teeth as if it’s a point of no return.
lines.zh: Ami 透过一个半碎的微笑点头,压抑的喜悦从她的齿间泄出,仿佛那是某条不可回头的界线。

lines.en: In some ways, I think it might be.
lines.zh: 从某种意义上说,也许确实是。

lines.en: But just like the morning’s first moments of joy, I suppress them enough to crawl out of bed and hug my [niece].
lines.zh: 但正如每个清晨最初的那几缕喜悦,我把它们压下去,够爬下床、抱住我的 [niece] 就好。

lines.en: She cries into my shoulder without saying a word.
lines.zh: 她一言不发地在我肩头哭。

lines.en: She grows stronger by the day.
lines.zh: 她一天比一天坚强。

lines.en: I fade into the background.
lines.zh: 而我退到了背景里。

lines.en: The two of us make our way to the bus stop and Ami talks a bit about how she spent the majority of last night filtering through boxes in the attic that once belonged to her mother.
lines.zh: 我们俩走向公交站,Ami 断断续续说起,昨晚她大半夜都在整理阁楼里她母亲的遗物箱。

lines.en: She tells me about how much she’s been missing her lately and how the recent increase of exposure to the sun has reminded her of her youth.
lines.zh: 她告诉我,她最近有多想她;最近日晒变多,又让她想起了自己的童年。

lines.en: She says this as if her youth has already vanished.
lines.zh: 她说这话的口吻,仿佛她的童年早已消逝。

lines.en: In a sense, I can see why she would think that.
lines.zh: 某种程度上,我能理解她为什么会这么想。

lines.en: The world was stripped away from her, leaving nothing but a melancholic deadbeat to care for her when he can’t even properly care for himself.
lines.zh: 世界从她身上被整个剥走,只留下一个忧郁潦倒的家伙照顾她——而那个家伙连自己都照顾不好。

lines.en: Only now, in this second shot at life, are the traces of her youth resurfacing- and even those are plagued by an unending misery in which she’ll never be able to truly overcome them for she can never grow old.
lines.zh: 直到如今,在这第二次的人生里,她童年的痕迹才重新浮上水面——即便如此,它们仍被无尽的苦涩缠着:她永远无法真正跨过去,因为她永远无法老去。

lines.en: We’re all trapped in cages resembling personal hells, and I often forget how cramped hers is sometimes.
lines.zh: 我们全都困在形似私人地狱的牢笼里,而我时常忘记,她的那间有时有多逼仄。

lines.en: It wouldn’t have to be that way if she’d only stop leaving so much room for me.
lines.zh: 如果她肯停止为我留下那么多空间,原本不必如此。

lines.en: We get on the bus and sit near the back. No one else rides with us.
lines.zh: 我们上了公交,坐在靠后的位置。没有别人和我们同乘。

lines.en: The sun sneaks higher than the trees and the clouds and blinds me to the point where I need to give up a hand just to block its rays for the duration of the trip.
lines.zh: 太阳悄悄爬过树梢与云层,晃得我只好牺牲一只手,挡一路的光。

lines.en: It makes it harder to pay attention to Ami’s recollection of her nightmare, but I do what I can because I know how hard it must be for her to tell me about it.
lines.zh: 这让我更难集中精神听 Ami 讲她的噩梦,但我尽力了,因为我知道,把这些讲出口对她来说有多难。

lines.en: It goes something like this:
lines.zh: 梦大概是这样的:

lines.en: She got to dance with her mom.
lines.zh: 她和妈妈一起跳舞了。

lines.en: O world-
lines.zh: 哦,世界——

lines.en: Where have you gone?
lines.zh: 你去哪儿了?

lines.en: Ami stands before the resting place of her parents in complete silence, trying to find the words to summarize all of the anguish she’s felt without them.
lines.zh: Ami 一言不发地站在父母安息之地前,努力寻找一句话,好概括没有他们的这些年里所有的苦。

lines.en: I’m sure she’ll counteract it with tinges of good things, but are there truly enough of them to offset the underlying misery in what it means to be eternally alone?
lines.zh: 我确信她之后会用好事的片段来中和,可「永远孤独」底色里那种深层的悲,真的有几件好事足以抵消吗?

lines.en: Are those fleeting moments of joy joyous enough to quell even a fraction of the pain she must have felt tying a sash around her mother’s dress?
lines.zh: 她给妈妈的裙腰系上腰带时想必感到的那种痛,那些转瞬即逝的欢愉,够抵消哪怕一丝一毫吗?

lines.en: What about the feelings that spilled from whatever mirror she glanced into to make sure it fit right?
lines.zh: 她照镜子确认裙子合身时,从镜子里涌出来的那些感受呢?

lines.en: What sort of things will she say to quiet the rumbling beneath us?
lines.zh: 她会说些什么,来平息我们脚下这阵轰鸣?

lines.en: And what should I say to her when they all fall flat?
lines.zh: 而等那些话都落了空,我又该对她说什么?

lines.en: Ten more minutes of silence.
lines.zh: 又沉默了十分钟。

lines.en: Then words.
lines.zh: 然后,是话语。

lines.en: : You looked better in this than I do.
lines.zh: : 你穿这条比我好看。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ll ever be as tall as you, so I made a few adjustments to keep it from dragging.
lines.zh: : 我大概永远也长不到你那么高,所以我改了几针,免得拖地。

lines.en: : You always got upset with me when I got my dresses dirty...so I didn’t want to disappoint you...because I know you’re always watching.
lines.zh: : 我以前把裙子弄脏,你总会生我的气……所以我不想让你失望……因为我知道你一直都在看着。

lines.en: : I wonder if you’d still seem as tall if I got to stand next to you today?
lines.zh: : 如果我今天能站在你身边,你还会显得那么高吗?

lines.en: : When I was little, it kind of felt like you were the biggest thing of all.
lines.zh: : 我小时候,总觉得你是世界上最大的东西。

lines.en: : But with a name like yours, I guess that was kind of bound to happen, huh?
lines.zh: : 不过,叫这个名字的话,这也算注定的吧?

lines.en: : So...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 那么……我想想……

lines.en: : Oh! We had another Christmas party recently.
lines.zh: : 哦!我们最近又办了一次圣诞派对!

lines.en: : There was a little bit of drama, but I think most of us had fun overall.
lines.zh: : 中间出了一点小风波,不过总的来说大家都玩得挺开心。

lines.en: : I sang in front of everyone, too! And, just so you know, I’m a lot better now than I used to be when we would sing together.
lines.zh: : 我还当着所有人的面唱歌了!告诉你,我现在唱得比从前我们一起唱的时候好多了。

lines.en: : You had such a beautiful voice.
lines.zh: : 你的声音那么好听。

lines.en: : I still get that old song you’d sing to me in bed stuck in my head every now and then.
lines.zh: : 你以前在床上唱给我听的那首老歌,偶尔还会卡在我脑子里。

lines.en: : Daisy...Daisy...Give me your answer do...and look! My hairpin even has one in it! Nice touch, right?
lines.zh: : Daisy……Daisy……给我你的回答……你看!我的发卡上还别着一朵!很用心吧?

lines.en: : I miss you, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我想你,妈妈。

lines.en: : More than anything in the world.
lines.zh: : 胜过世界上的一切。

lines.en: : Sensei misses you too, but he’s too afraid of looking weak around me to admit it.
lines.zh: : Sensei 也想你,但他太怕在我面前显得软弱,不肯承认。

lines.en: : Um...I’m doing okay in school, I think...
lines.zh: : 呃……我上学还算顺利吧,我想……

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard to tell with how Sensei grades stuff. When there...is stuff to grade. Which...isn’t very often.
lines.zh: : 以 Sensei 的批改标准,这不太好说。在有……东西可批改的时候。这种时候……并不多。

lines.en: : And...um...the manga club is going well. We’re all reading this one series I think that you’d like a lot.
lines.zh: : 还有……嗯……漫画社一切都好。我们在读一部作品,我觉得你会很喜欢。

lines.en: : The plants from our old house are still alive somehow. I’ve been taking good care of them since you’ve been gone and they’ve lasted way longer than I ever thought they would.
lines.zh: : 老房子的那些植物还活着,不知道怎么做到的。你走以后,我一直好好照顾它们,它们撑得比我想象中久多了。

lines.en: : Um...I’m a maid now. But not like a real maid. I just work at a cafe. I’d show you the dress if I could.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我现在是女仆了。不过不是真的那种女仆,只是在咖啡厅打工。要是可以,我真想穿给你看。

lines.en: : I still eat right before bed sometimes, which is a thing I probably shouldn’t be telling you since you’ll get mad at me- but I kind of promised I’d tell you everything, so...
lines.zh: : 我偶尔还是会睡前吃东西,这件事大概不该告诉你,不然你会生我的气——但我答应过什么都说,所以……

lines.en: : I miss you? Which I think I’ve said already but I really miss you so I’m just going to say it again.
lines.zh: : 我想你?这个我好像已经说过了,但我真的很想你,所以再说一遍。

lines.en: : Daddy, too. Can you tell him that? Sensei’s been doing an okay job as my new dad, but he doesn’t pay enough attention to me sometimes and...uhh...
lines.zh: : 爸爸也是。能帮我转告他吗?Sensei 当我的新爸爸干得还凑合,但他有时候不太关心我,还有……呃……

lines.en: : Did I...mention I...really miss you, Mom?...
lines.zh: : 我……是不是……已经说过我很想你,妈妈?……

lines.en: : I miss you too, my sweet girl.
lines.zh: : 我也想你,我的甜心。

lines.en: : There’s not a single day that goes by where I don’t think of you.
lines.zh: : 没有一天,我的脑海里不浮现你的影子。

lines.en: : I’m sorry I can’t be there to watch you grow.
lines.zh: : 对不起,妈妈没办法陪在你身边,看你长大。

lines.en: : I’m sorry I can’t be there to help you fix up my old dresses- which you look beautiful in, by the way. Much better than I ever did.
lines.zh: : 对不起,妈妈没办法帮你改我那些旧裙子——顺便说一句,你穿着真好看。比我当年好看多了。

lines.en: : But most of all-
lines.zh: : 但最重要的是——

lines.en: : I’m sorry you feel so alone.
lines.zh: : 对不起,你觉得自己那么孤单。

lines.en: : I do too.
lines.zh: : 妈妈也觉得孤单。

lines.en: : I’m always here, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,我一直都在。

lines.en: : Even if you can’t see me.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你看不见我。

lines.en: : Even if you can’t feel me.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你感觉不到我。

lines.en: : I can still feel you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 可我还感觉得到你,Ami。

lines.en: : You’re as warm as ever.
lines.zh: : 你和从前一样温暖。

lines.en: : Do you think she’s here, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她在这里吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Do you...think she’s listening?
lines.zh: : 你……觉得她在听吗?

lines.en: : I hope I look okay...I really wanted to be pretty for her today.
lines.zh: : 我希望自己看起来还好……我今天真的很想为她打扮得漂漂亮亮的。

lines.en: : You are...
lines.zh: : 你很漂亮……

lines.en: : I’m sure she’d be proud.
lines.zh: : 我确信她会骄傲。

lines.en: : Can you look at me, Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami,能看着我吗?

lines.en: : I didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : I have to go now. I have things to do.
lines.zh: : 我得走了。我还有事要做。

lines.en: : But take care of yourself, okay?
lines.zh: : 但你要照顾好自己,好吗?

lines.en: : And your uncle too. He’s helpless on his own.
lines.zh: : 还有你叔叔。他一个人什么都干不成。

lines.en: : I love you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,Ami。

lines.en: : I love you, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,妈妈。

lines.en: : She was here...
lines.zh: : 她刚才在……

lines.en: : I know she was...
lines.zh: : 我知道她在……

lines.en: A gust of wind tears thousands of cherry blossoms away from their home and off to someplace new.
lines.zh: 一阵风卷走千万片樱花,把它们带向某个新的去处。

lines.en: My eyes follow them because there’s somewhere else they’d rather not look.
lines.zh: 我的目光追随它们,因为除了那里,我的眼睛不敢落在别处。

lines.en: Ami falls to her knees and begins to sob uncontrollably.
lines.zh: Ami 双膝跪地,开始放声大哭。

lines.en: It was only a matter of time.
lines.zh: 这只是时间问题。

lines.en: But, all things considered, she’s been a lot more composed this time around than the last.
lines.zh: 但总的来说,这一次的她,比上一次镇定多了。

lines.en: I won’t pretend to know why or even search my mind for clues, for I know the second I find any that they’ll pour out from my mouth even faster than the tears in Ami’s eyes.
lines.zh: 我不会假装知道为什么,甚至不会在脑中搜寻线索——因为我很清楚,那些线索一旦被我找到,就会从嘴里倾泻而出,比 Ami 眼里的泪还快。

lines.en: This is a moment for her and her only.
lines.zh: 这一刻只属于她一个人。

lines.en: I can not allow my constant need to involve myself in every facet of everyone’s lives to get in the way of that.
lines.zh: 我那无处不在、非要插手每个人生活每个角落的坏毛病,绝不能坏在这里。

lines.en: She must cry.
lines.zh: 她必须哭。

lines.en: She must cry until her eyes swell shut.
lines.zh: 她必须哭到眼睛肿起来。

lines.en: And then she must get off the ground-
lines.zh: 然后她必须站起来——

lines.en: Wipe the dirt from her mother’s dress-
lines.zh: 拍掉妈妈裙子上的土——

lines.en: And smile.
lines.zh: 然后微笑。

lines.en: : Okay...now it’s your turn.
lines.zh: : 好……现在轮到你了。

lines.en: : My turn?
lines.zh: : 轮到我了?

lines.en: : They were important to you too, Sensei. You can’t just not speak to them.
lines.zh: : 他们对你也很重要,Sensei。你不能就这么不跟他们说话。

lines.en: : Ami, I don’t really want to ruin a good moment by expressing my thoughts on talking to the deceased.
lines.zh: : Ami,我可不太想在这么好的时刻,发表我对「和死者对话」的看法,把气氛毁了。

lines.en: : I bet they would talk to you if you were the one who died. I know I would.
lines.zh: : 要是死的是你,他们肯定会跟你说话的。换成我就一定会。

lines.en: : You’re not allowed to die, though. I love you too much.
lines.zh: : 反正你不许死。我太爱你了。

lines.en: : I will do my best to continue...indefinitely living.
lines.zh: : 那我会尽力……无限期地活下去。

lines.en: : Um...can I ask for something selfish?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我能提一个自私的请求吗?

lines.en: : I already told you that I’m not giving you an allowance anymore. Stop trying to revive that when you already have a job.
lines.zh: : 我已经说了,零花钱不会再有。别想着翻案,你都上班了。

lines.en: : The only reason I have a job is because you think all of the things I do for you aren’t worth new clothes and manga and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我之所以上班,还不是因为你觉得我为你做的一切,不值几件新衣服和几本漫画。

lines.en: : And I will remain steadfast in that belief, but please carry on with your selfish request, whatever that may be.
lines.zh: : 这个信念我会坚定不移,但请继续讲你的自私请求,无论它是什么。

lines.en: : I don’t want to go home just yet.
lines.zh: : 我还不想回家。

lines.en: : I want you to spend the entire day with me.
lines.zh: : 我要你今天一整天都陪着我。

lines.en: : I want it to be a real date.
lines.zh: : 我要一场真正的约会。

lines.en: : A real date sounds fine. Especially since I very likely know how it will end with you.
lines.zh: : 真正的约会,听着不错。尤其是,我已经很有把握知道和你约会会怎么收场。

lines.en: : Sensei! My parents are literally right there! You can’t say that!
lines.zh: : Sensei!我爸妈就站在那里!你不能说这种话!

lines.en: : Say what? It’s not like I said how it will end. I just-
lines.zh: : 说什么了?我可没说会怎么收场。我只是——

lines.en: : They were adults when they died! They will obviously know what you mean by that!
lines.zh: : 他们去世的时候已经是大人了!他们当然听得懂你这话什么意思!

lines.en: : Again, I technically didn’t do anything wrong just now.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,严格来讲,我刚才什么都没说错。

lines.en: : What do you mean by a “real” date, Ami? Because I’ve already told you that-
lines.zh: : 你说的「真正」的约会是什么意思,Ami?因为我已经告诉过你——

lines.en: : I know what you’ve told me. And I’m not expecting you to change that or do anything you think is weird that really isn’t that weird, but I understand.
lines.zh: : 你跟我说过的我都记得。我也没指望你改变,没指望你做那些你觉得怪、其实一点也不怪的事。我理解。

lines.en: : Even if nothing comes of it, I want to go on a date.
lines.zh: : 哪怕什么都不会发生,我也想去约会。

lines.en: : I want to spend the entire day with the person I love more than anything else in the world.
lines.zh: : 我想和这个世界上我最爱的人,共度完整的一天。

lines.en: : I deserve it every once in a while if you’re really not going to give me an allowance.
lines.zh: : 既然你真的不打算给我零花钱,偶尔也该给我这个补偿。

lines.en: : You know you’re really annoying sometimes, right?
lines.zh: : 你有时候真的很烦,你知道吗?

lines.en: : I’m supposed to be annoying. I’m your [niece].
lines.zh: : 我「该」烦。我是你的 [niece]。

lines.en: : I don’t really think it works that way...
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这个逻辑成立……

lines.en: : But fine. I’ll go on a date with you.
lines.zh: : 但好吧。我陪你约会。

lines.en: : Yay! A whole day with Sensei that I only kind of had to force out of him!
lines.zh: : 耶!和 Sensei 的完整一天!虽然是我半推半就榨出来的!

lines.en: : Here’s hoping the next part of it is significantly less painful and tear-filled than the first.
lines.zh: : 但愿接下来的部分,能比第一部分少一点眼泪、少一点痛。

lines.en: : Oh, it will be. I already know where we’re going. And it’s somewhere I think you’ll like a lot.
lines.zh: : 哦,会的。我已经想好去哪了。是个我觉得你会非常喜欢的地方。

lines.en: : That is a bold claim. There are not many things I like.
lines.zh: : 好大的口气。我喜欢的东西可不多。

lines.en: : Well, you just wait, Sensei. Because this place is going to knock your socks off.
lines.zh: : 那你就等着瞧吧,Sensei。那地方绝对会让你大吃一惊。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I just wanna talk to my mom one more time before we leave, okay?
lines.zh: : 我只是想在离开之前,再和妈妈说句话,好吗?

lines.en: : Obviously. Even I wouldn't say no to that.
lines.zh: : 当然。这种事,连我都不会拒绝。

lines.en: : Heheh~ You know you can talk too if-
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 你知道吗,你要是也想说——

lines.en: : I’ll be waiting at the entrance. Take your time.
lines.zh: : 我在入口等你。慢慢来。

lines.en: : Sensei! At least stay here if you’re not going to talk to them!
lines.zh: : Sensei!你要是不打算跟他们说话,至少陪我站在这里!

lines.en: Ami lowers herself to her knees and places both hands upon her parents’ grave.
lines.zh: Ami 双膝跪地,双手覆在父母的墓碑上。

lines.en: There are no gusts of wind or homeless cherry blossoms to distract me from the sight this time.
lines.zh: 这一次,没有卷走樱花的风,来把我的视线从这幅景象上引开。

lines.en: I watch her break down once again, knowing full well that it will likely not prepare me for the many more times I’ll have to watch her do this exact thing.
lines.zh: 我看着她再一次崩溃,心里很清楚:这不会让下一次好受多少——而那样的下一次,还会有很多。

lines.en: Some things, you can never get used to.
lines.zh: 有些事情,你永远无法习惯。

lines.en: And the pain of someone you genuinely love is one of them.
lines.zh: 你真心所爱之人的痛,就是其中之一。

lines.en: I press my hands together and attempt to pray for something to happen.
lines.zh: 我合起双手,试着祈祷点什么发生。

lines.en: Nothing happens.
lines.zh: 什么也没有发生。

lines.en: Not even a gust of wind.
lines.zh: 连一阵风都没有。

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
